subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate adverb to fill in the blank.

He comes here _________ .
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The adverb **"daily"** is used to indicate something that happens every day.
 
• In the context of the sentence, "He comes here _________," the most appropriate adverb to use is "daily" because it makes sense that someone comes to a place every day.
 
• The other options do not fit the context as well as** "daily."**
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

**Correct Sentence:** *"He comes here **daily**."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "lately" **– This means recently and does not fit the context of the sentence.
 
• **Option 2: "quickly"** – This describes the speed of the action, not the frequency, so it is not appropriate here.
 
• **Option 3: "formerly"** – This means in the past and does not fit the context of the sentence.
 
• **Option 5: (blank)** – This is not a valid option as it provides no adverb to complete the sentence.
